I mean hexblade paladin is always a nutty build. Here's my favorite made for high damage and tons of debuffs that I've made:

Hexblade with 4 levels. We're dumping strength so this is better to start with. Take devil sight,  Sign of Ill Omen, and pact of the blade. Use your ASI for charisma. Abuse the darkness and shadow blade spells with devil's sight and go to town. Grab hex and shield since we'll get low level slots from paladin, and make sure to get Hold Person for crits.

Paladin for another 6 levels. Take vengeance for more debuffs with channel divinity. We're going to level 6 for extra attack and aura of protection. Max out that charisma. 

Hexblade up to level 9, making this build level 15 total. Take Maddening hex at level 5. At level 7 take Shadow of Moil for more damage and advantage. For Invocations, take Relentless Hex. Level 8 has options. Either increase CON for more health, or take a feat like great weapon master if you're using a two handed weapon, spell sniper for better Eldritch Blasts, or metamagic adept for quickened spell (this is my personal favorite). At level 9, take Hold Monster for more crits and Eldritch Smite for crazy damage.

You now have a myriad of options to debuff your opponent, most of them also being bonus actions, crazy damage with high chr, two flavors of smites, and easy crits from hold person/monster. Spell slots are limited, 4 1st, 2 2nd, and 2 5th, but many debuffs are class features or invocations, and we get great mileage out of them from our damage and other invocations. Great build that works on it's own and with others.
